# nico_vpc_peering (Data Source)

VPC Peering allows Instances in one VPC to communicate with Instances in another VPC on the same Site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_vpc_peering" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "vpc_peering_name" {
  value = data.nico_vpc_peering.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the resource to retrieve. When set, returns a single resource.
- `is_multi_tenant` (String) Optional filter by peering tenancy type (single-tenant or multi-tenant).
- `peer_tenant_id` (String) Optional filter by tenant ID of a VPC involved in the peering. Repeat the parameter to match multiple tenants.
- `site_id` (String) Optional Site ID filter. If provided, caller must have access to the specified Site.
- `status` (String) Optional filter by peering status. Repeat the parameter to match multiple statuses.
- `vpc_id` (String) Optional filter by VPC ID involved in the peering as either vpc1 or vpc2. Repeat the parameter to match multiple VPCs.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date and time when the VPC peering was created
- `site` (Attributes) Summary of the Site where the peering exists. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--site))
- `tenant` (Attributes) Summary of the tenant that created the VPC peering. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tenant))
- `tenant_id` (String) ID of the tenant that created the VPC peering.
- `updated` (String) Date and time when the VPC peering was last updated
- `vpc1` (Attributes) Summary of the first VPC in the peering. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpc1))
- `vpc1_id` (String) ID of the first VPC in the peering
- `vpc2` (Attributes) Summary of the second VPC in the peering. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpc2))
- `vpc2_id` (String) ID of the second VPC in the peering

<a id="nestedatt--site--capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `site.capabilities`

Read-Only:

- `dps_power_management` (Boolean) Whether this Site accepts non-empty power resource groups and power profiles for DPS power management. When false, omission and explicit clearing remain allowed.
- `flow` (Boolean) Whether the Site supports Flow-based operations
- `image_based_operating_system` (Boolean) Whether the Site supports image-based operating system provisioning
- `native_networking` (Boolean) Whether the Site supports native networking
- `network_security_group` (Boolean) Whether the Site supports Network Security Groups
- `nv_link_partition` (Boolean) Whether the Site supports NVLink partitioning
- `vpc_slaac` (Boolean) Whether the latest successfully stored Site configuration inventory reports that Core supports VPCs with SLAAC enabled. False also represents a missing Site configuration or an inventory report that omits the capability. This value is managed by Site configuration inventory and cannot be updated through the Site API.
